value.text: Mondrian/Holtzman Trust claims the work is still under copyright

As the Catalog of Copyright Entries shows no listings for Mondarian anytime in the 1940s, it seems safe to say that the artist did not register any of hos New York paintings, meaning [] has always been in the public domain in the United States due to failure to comply with formalities required at the time.
Mondrian/Holtzman Trust now manages the worldwide rights, including digital reproduction rights.
